name: ingre
description: Shopping app for the home cook

scripts.develop: concurrently "cd server && npm run watch" "cd client && npm start"
scripts.install: cd server && npm i && cd ../client && npm i
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix client test -- --coverage --coverageThreshold='{"global":{"branches":100,"functions":100,"lines":100,"statements":100}}' && npm --prefix server test

author: Leo Wong
